This Egyptian cross-sectional study examined 111 clinical isolates of Klebsiella pneumoniae, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa from 2020-2021. Carbapenem resistance was extremely high, affecting 98.2% of isolates. Colistin resistance was also concerning, especially in K. pneumoniae, although mcr genes were absent. blaNDM and blaOXA-48-like carbapenemase genes predominated, ofte
